cohort: Infants of 1223 pregnant women carrying a child at a high risk of allergy (at least one parent with allergic disease)
finding: While probiotic intervention did not significantly reduce the prevalence of allergic diseases in the total cohort, it did protect the Caesarean-delivered subgroup from allergic disease and eczema.
mod_finding: Probiotic intervention protected the Caesarean-delivered subgroup from allergic disease and eczema.
